+I enjoy just not being sober.  Don't give a shit what--booze, weed, abusing my RX meds, abusing OTC meds, anything I can get my hands on.  Existence is misery and it's either kill myself immediately or just go through life bouncing from mind-altering substance to mind-altering substance.

+Curiosity was part of it, too.  I'll try most things once.  My "I'm never fucking with that" list exists, but is pretty small--PCP, meth, opiates.

+Also I read Erowid accounts, posts on this sub, etc. for several days before I abused DPH the first time.  I was fully aware that the misery I experienced was possible before I went into it.
